scope: Assess the existing approved NiceGUI Base identity. No external fashion/style baseline is imposed.
character: Calm, dense, engineering-first reference/product UI. Navigation and governed surfaces dominate; imagery is intentionally limited to useful previews/state illustrations.

dimensions.assessment: Consistent with the repository constitution: restrained internal engineering product, minimal decorative chrome, no trend-driven redesign proposed.
Clear shell/page/section/label/data hierarchy in inspected desktop/mobile surfaces; values and labels generally remain task-readable. 200% zoom remains unproven.
Workbench/catalog/data and analytics surfaces convey dense simultaneous needs without broad decorative-card inflation; phone layouts preserve a readable single-column path.
Application/workbench purpose, current named object, decision area and subordinate evidence are ordered in inspected normal-state surfaces.
Grouping and semantic section gaps remain coherent across canonical surfaces and reviewed constrained/narrow/holdout/resize diagnostics.

Boundaries separate panels, table regions, forms and overlays where content/action ownership changes; no material decorative-card inflation found. Chart theme finding is specifically a plot canvas parity failure.
Observed role-based control/surface/overlay vocabulary is consistent with the 10/14/18 token law; no material arbitrary-radius pattern found.

Neutral structure and semantic/action accents are consistent in normal light surfaces. In eleven existing explicit-dark chart diagnostics, dark shell and declared dark chart meet a white plot canvas; paired System-dark renders are dark.
Primary actions and selected/current objects carry most salience in normal views; affected white plot canvas gains unintended salience in Dark mode.
Company-owned labeled controls and icon treatments appear coherent in reviewed gallery/chart surface pixels; source contracts govern semantic labels. No material inconsistency established.
Previews and state illustrations serve capability comprehension/recovery; no decorative imagery debt observed.
Source owns reduced-motion tokens and CSS behavior. Static atlas and available diagnostics do not establish all live motion/transition outcomes.

Charts identify measured object and provide toolbar/data alternative metadata; tables and analysis keep dense evidence available. Selection universe and full-detail recovery transitions are not completely established by static screenshots.
Visible labels/actions are operational and direct. Dark plot background mismatch makes chart color semantics less reliable/readable for dark users.
Canonical mobile and R16 constrained/narrow/holdout/resize diagnostics show recomposition rather than merely scaled desktop, with route context and labels retained in inspected samples.

evidence_basis: 288 canonical PNGs independently pixel-inspected through 27 family contact sheets.
84 stress-profile PNGs represented in 14 reviewed route sheets.
All 32 published explicit-dark/system-dark chart diagnostic PNGs represented in 6 reviewed theme-comparison sheets.
Representative chart-kind diagnostics reviewed; all contact sheets are derived solely from the exact R16 bundle.
non_claims: No universal perfection or numeric beauty score.
No accountable human visual acceptance or user-preference result.
No screen-reader/AT, native/physical-device or CHG-59 qualification.
